title: Made a naval RTS for Android with Claude Code + Codex: Age of Empires / Empire Earth vibes
author: Comfortable-Lab-9035
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev!



Made this inspired on Empire Earth mostly, but Age of Empires has a touch on it too. My favorite part was always the battles, not the 20 minutes of chopping wood before them. So I made NavaStorm, a top-down naval RTS for Android where you go straight to the fight. No farming, no grinding: build your fleet and attack.

\- Ships, planes, ground units and a few mythical (dragons, krakens and others)

\- Campaign, Survival, Conquest+ and Destroy the Command Center

\- Random match mode with a scenario creator for quick custom games

My fav. playmode is conquest+, where you receive some coins (and the enemy) with a timer to direct request units and attack (or defend). 

AI workflow: Unity + C#. Most of the code was written with Claude Code and Codex (Opus 5.5 xhigh + sol 6.1 xhigh, but mostly Opus). The 3D models come from Blender Python scripts the agents wrote, not hand-modeled.

It has a tutorial with the basics.

It's free on Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.navastorm.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.navastorm.game)



I'd love feedback, especially on balance and controls. Happy to answer anything about the workflow!
